title: Let a frozen frontier MLLM steer primitive actions through a minimal observe/step tool pair
operation: expose the environment as a non-advancing observe tool plus a bounded-batch step tool and leave looking, commitment size, recovery and stopping to the model

title: Keep dense geometry inside harness tools and return numeric receipts to the model on request
operation: hold depth, point clouds, calibration and maps inside tools and let the model query pixels, regions or map entries, receiving compact numeric receipts before it commits motion

title: Model proposes a visual target; harness back-projects, checks feasibility and executes or asks to reselect
operation: let the model pick a pixel or editable target pose, have the harness back-project/solve IK and plan, check feasibility, and return execute or reselect/revise feedback

title: Restrict the model to a discrete semantic action vocabulary executed by a deterministic or frozen low-level executor
operation: restrict model output to a fixed vocabulary of semantic actions and map each one deterministically to a lower-level executor

title: Offer extra tools as optional calls beside primitive actions and let the model choose
operation: add perception/navigation or MCP tools as optional calls next to the primitive interface rather than replacing it, and let the model decide when to call them

title: Insert a separate VLM that turns images into text for the planner
operation: convert camera images into text (scene description, before/after differences, completion judgement) with a separate frozen VLM and feed that to the planner

title: Replace raw shell interaction with compact LM-oriented commands (agent-computer interface)
operation: replace low-level shell interaction with a small set of LM-oriented commands with summarized, windowed returns, tuned by trajectory inspection

title: Have the frozen planner write code cells that compose perception, geometry and motion primitives
operation: let the frozen frontier model write and run code that composes primitives, computes geometry, branches and retries locally, and returns only requested observations

title: Train a compact policy to be invoked by a planner through a typed call
operation: train a compact policy whose input is a typed planner call (tool family + local instruction, or a JSON command) and expose it as a callable tool for multi-step motion

title: Wrap a frozen VLA as a planner-controlled primitive and inspect before committing
operation: wrap a frozen VLA as a primitive the planner stages, bounds, inspects and retries, or whose inputs/outputs it edits before approving

title: Treat each model proposal as a request and gate it with an external checker before execution
operation: check each proposed edit, navigation target, STOP or route outside the model with a cheap checker and either dispatch it or reject it with structured feedback

title: Run the executor until a completion or stagnation monitor fires, then hand control back to the planner
operation: keep the low-level executor on the current subgoal until a success detector or progress-threshold/stagnation rule fires, then let the planner advance or replan

title: After a scored attempt, let the agent write and run a diagnostic program before resetting
operation: after each attempt, have the coding agent synthesize a separate View/Probe program to gather evidence on unresolved outcomes, then decide FINISH or REGENERATE

title: Give the coding-agent solver checkpoint/backtrack and parameter-search tools over full simulator state
operation: add a checkpoint tree over simulator states, CMA-ES parameter search, parallel program sweeps and an assessment log to the agent's native harness

title: Rebuild each call's context from a bounded within-episode selection with retrieval for the rest
operation: rebuild each model call from a short window of recent records/images plus a compact map or graph, and give access to older history only by retrieval

title: Summarize repeated-task experience into notes injected into later episodes
operation: run the system on a task, have a model summarize what worked and failed into notes or parameterized traces, and inject them into later episodes' planner context

title: Mine, consolidate and review a reusable skill library from successful executions or demonstrations
operation: extract reusable skills from successes or demos, have a frontier model consolidate/edit/review them, and expose the frozen library at run time

title: Compile a successful harness trajectory into a planner-free replay card
operation: compile each successful trajectory into a card with anchor-relative waypoints and VLA prompts, re-localize anchors at deployment, and replay without online planning

title: With the model frozen, let an optimizer agent revise the harness from raw traces and keep improvements
operation: let a coding-agent optimizer read prior harness code and raw execution traces, propose harness edits, evaluate them on a search set, and keep improvements

title: Teacher revises a text playbook from comparing its own and a light agent's runs; accept when the light agent matches the teacher
operation: initialize a playbook from teacher rollouts, have the teacher compare teacher vs light-recipient executions and propose revisions, and accept the first revision whose recipient success reaches the teacher's

title: Alternate RL on the student with harness revisions accepted only when they help the current checkpoint
operation: alternate blocks of RL on the student (harness frozen) with harness revisions proposed from those trajectories, accepting a revision only if it improves outcomes under the fixed current checkpoint

title: SFT a compact VLM on success-filtered frontier-teacher turns so it pilots the identical harness
operation: log the frontier teacher's per-turn reasoning and tool call while it runs the harness, keep successful episodes, and SFT a compact VLM on next-response prediction from the identical context

title: Train the student on teacher data while the student's interface lacks part of the teacher's harness
operation: train the student on teacher data while dropping harness components from the student's context, either by giving it a minimal context or by deleting and rewriting teacher turns that depend on removed components

title: Branch successful teacher runs from saved simulator checkpoints to add recovery and diversity, keeping only verified branches
operation: save simulator checkpoints along a successful teacher run, branch from them with injected failures or varied scene/strategy/phase/noise, and keep only branches that pass verification

title: Use a frontier LLM with privileged simulator state to iterate a program teacher until it succeeds
operation: have a frontier LLM or coding agent with full simulator state write or revise a solver program from failure logs until it succeeds, and keep its successes as demonstrations for a vision-only student

title: A privileged rule teacher acts step by step in the student's skill vocabulary, with templated state reasoning
operation: let a privileged rule teacher choose each next skill from the student's vocabulary after observing the result, annotate each step with templated state-estimation reasoning from sim ground truth, and train the student to output reasoning then action

title: Instead of cloning a privileged expert, estimate its missing state inputs and run it frozen
operation: train a perception module to predict the privileged expert's missing state inputs from cameras, feed them with proprioception to the frozen expert, and ramp from state-MSE to action-MSE through the expert's Jacobian

title: Repair the student's failed episode from its earliest harmful step and admit only validated corrections
operation: on a failed student rollout, have a black-box teacher locate the earliest harmful step, keep the prefix, replace from there, and admit the correction by an admission rule before SFT

title: A frontier harnessing agent reviews every student proposal and replaces unsound ones with corrections valid in the minimal harness
operation: intercept each student proposal before execution, pass or replace it with the smallest correction valid under the minimal target harness, and SFT the student on accepted responses for minimal-harness deployment

title: Query the teacher only at learner states flagged by a gate
operation: during learner rollouts, query the teacher only at states flagged by a gate and train on those teacher actions

title: Relabel learner-visited states with a privileged expert, when dynamics allow
operation: relabel learner-visited states with a privileged expert or geometric label generator and aggregate DAgger-style, choosing this over RL only when latent dynamics are near-deterministic

title: Start student RL from states produced by teacher-student interaction
operation: start the student's sparse-reward RL rollouts from intermediate states derived from teacher-student interaction instead of the task start

title: On-policy distillation from a white-box teacher's token logits at student-visited states
operation: roll out the student, reward each sampled action token by the negative student-teacher log-ratio, and update by policy gradient, using reverse KL rather than forward KL or argmax relabels

title: Score the student's own tokens with a privileged-context copy of itself and add the divergence to RL
operation: let the student sample without privileged info, score its tokens with the same weights conditioned on privileged context, and add a per-token divergence to GRPO, optionally gating which responses are distilled

title: Train one model jointly under privileged and deployment-context views, deploying only the plain view
operation: train one model at once on privileged-context and deployment-context prompts and deploy only the plain view

title: Sample target actions from a model copy given privileged context, then verify or match
operation: sample target actions from a copy of the model given privileged context and use them as student targets after verification or as an agreement reward

title: Reward student candidates by semantic agreement with black-box teacher actions at the same state
operation: at each learner state, sample several teacher actions and student candidates, reward candidates by semantic match, optimize PPO-clipped, and advance the environment with the best candidate

title: Prefer the teacher's harness-conditioned action over its harness-stripped action at student states
operation: at student-visited states, sample teacher actions with and without harness text, apply a pairwise preference for the harness-conditioned action, filter invalid positives by harness rules, and add response distillation

title: Train the policy through an unmodified harness by capturing its model calls at an API proxy
operation: redirect the harness's model endpoint to a recording proxy that captures exact contexts, tokens and logprobs, attach outcome reward, and train the open-weight policy for deployment in the same harness

title: Assemble captured harness calls into training rows by prefix rules and keep credit at rollout level
operation: partition captured calls into append-only prefix chains or exact-prefix merges, mask harness-inserted tokens, and compute group baselines and loss normalization over rollouts rather than samples

title: Curate a trainable task band and harden the sandbox against reward leakage
operation: withhold verifier-only state until grading, block egress and git history, mask infrastructure failures, and keep tasks of intermediate base-policy success

title: Train the policy under the same context-construction rules it will be deployed with
operation: train the policy under the context-construction rules (compression, summaries, prompt format) used at deployment rather than applying them only at inference

title: RL a small coder/planner model directly inside an embodied code harness on sparse success
operation: train a small model with GRPO/PPO on verifiable simulator success inside the code-as-action harness, without teacher trajectories

title: Fork the simulator at each decision step, score completions with a privileged dense reward, continue from the best
operation: sample a group of completions per decision step, roll each in a forked simulator branch, score with a dense privileged reward plus brevity term, update with GRPO and continue from the best branch

title: Inject teacher-written skill hints into RL rollouts only, removed at evaluation
operation: have a frozen teacher contrast a success and a failure rollout to write a short screened skill, inject it during GRPO rollouts for assisted tasks, and remove it at evaluation

title: Initialize from teacher-derived data so every task has nonzero success before sparse-reward RL
operation: initialize the student from teacher-derived data so target tasks have nonzero success, then run sparse or outcome-based RL

title: Cross frozen models with harnesses on fixed tasks and report harness variance with paired statistics
operation: run a model-by-harness grid with everything else fixed and report harness variance, model variance, ranking reversals, paired bootstrap CIs and tokens per solved task

title: Hold the model fixed and toggle one harness component or layer at a time
operation: hold the backbone (or distilled student) fixed and add, remove or swap one harness component or layer at a time

title: Swap the model under a fixed embodied harness and the harness under a fixed model on the same episodes
operation: hold the harness fixed and swap the model, and hold the model fixed and swap the harness or loop director, on fixed embodied episodes

title: Decompose outcomes into failure categories, endpoints and per-task repeat patterns
operation: classify failed runs by cause or terminal state and tasks by repeated-run outcome pattern, and report these with pass rate

title: Re-price runs from raw per-turn usage and reconcile against billed spend
operation: re-price every run from raw per-turn usage with explicit cache terms, reconcile against the ledger and billed spend
